minutes.headline: TCP Building Design Committee held its kickoff with the architect, set April meeting dates and gathered visioning input.
minutes.summary: The committee met its architect team for a kickoff covering schedule, site surveys, visioning questions, traffic study and public outreach. Members described goals for the TC Passios building: town offices, community space, flexible meeting rooms, security from the school use, and cost-effectiveness. After the architects left, the committee tentatively agreed to meet April 8 and April 22 and discussed the contract scope.

attendees.role: presenter, project manager and lead structural engineer

budget_items.what_was_said: Architects will attach high-level dollar ranges to options in the pre-schematic phase and refine them as design advances.
An appendix with a more detailed scope of services was sent and the contract would be executed once the committee is satisfied; contract and invoicing go to the procurement officer.
A member said the project depends on keeping the budget in mind, with town offices the focus of spending.
A member asked that the building not require heavy capital investment over twenty years.
A member said a vacant building costs the town money every year, citing another town's old school.
figures_as_heard: a couple hundred thousand dollars a year

budget_items.what_was_said: Members discussed optional additions to the scope such as hazardous materials and geotechnical work; phase one environmental is included.
Members suggested outreach materials and printing be done by the architect within the contract.

decisions.decision: Tentatively set committee meetings for April 8 and April 22 ahead of spring Town Meeting.
Architects will schedule a joint walkthrough and survey with all engineers, coordinating through the procurement officer and John.
Stakeholders such as the Senior Center, Teen Center and Boys and Girls Club to be consulted in visioning sessions.
Committee communication with the architects will flow through the procurement officer because of Open Meeting Law limits.

what_happened.line: The TCP Building Design Committee held its kickoff with the architect team on the schedule, site surveys, visioning, a traffic study and public outreach.
The committee tentatively set meetings for April 8 and April 22, ahead of spring Town Meeting; no votes were taken.
Architects will attach high-level dollar ranges to options in the pre-schematic phase and refine them as the design advances.
Committee communication with the architects will go through the procurement officer because of Open Meeting Law limits.
Senior Center, Teen Center and Boys and Girls Club are to be consulted in visioning sessions; contract scope additions were discussed afterward.

why_it_matters: This is the early design stage for a possible reuse of the TC Passios building for town offices and community space, and the cost ranges produced here will shape any funding request residents may later be asked to vote on at Town Meeting.
Questions raised about long-term upkeep and the yearly cost of vacant buildings bear on future tax-supported capital and maintenance spending.
